description: This file is an AsciiDoc documentation source that explains the concept, setup, implementation, and usage of an 'Object Walk' in Git, including both commit and object traversal techniques. It provides step-by-step instructions, code snippets, and explanations for implementing custom Git commands such as 'git walken'.

classes.name: struct rev_cmdline_info
classes.description: Structure reflecting command-line parameters for revision/query options, including object identifiers, whence, flags, and counts related to the object walk.

classes.name: struct rev_info
classes.description: Core structure representing revision information used during Git's object and commit traversal processes, including sorting, ordering, filters, and flags.

methods.name: cmd_walken
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git walken' command, initializing configuration, setting up revision info, and performing either commit or object traversal based on configuration.

methods.name: repo_config
methods.description: Sets up repository-specific configuration callbacks, including custom configs for 'walken'.

methods.name: repo_init_revisions
methods.description: Initializes the 'rev_info' structure based on the repository and prefix, preparing it for revision traversal.

methods.name: get_commit_format
methods.description: Configures the format for displaying commits, e.g., 'oneline'.

methods.name: add_head_to_pending
methods.description: Adds the HEAD revision to the list of pending objects to process during revision walking.

methods.name: prepare_revision_walk
methods.description: Prepares the 'rev_info' for traversal, establishing internal data structures.

methods.name: get_revision
methods.description: Iterator function to retrieve the next revision (commit or object) during traversal.

methods.name: traverse_commit_list
methods.description: Traverses the list of commits/objects, applying provided callbacks for each object.

methods.name: traverse_commit_list_filtered
methods.description: Similar to 'traverse_commit_list' but with filtering capabilities to omit certain objects.

methods.name: walken_show_commit
methods.description: Callback function invoked for commit objects, typically to process or display commit data.

methods.name: walken_show_object
methods.description: Callback function invoked for non-commit objects (trees, blobs, tags), to process or count them.

methods.name: walken_object_walk
methods.description: Performs a general object traversal, counting and reporting various object types, with optional filtering.
